hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit push\b'; then python3 ./scripts/check_alembic_heads.py; fi

hooks.prompt: A git push is being attempted. Inspect the current conversation: were at least TWO separate Agent tool calls made since the last git push, acting as pre-deploy reviewers, and were their findings read and addressed? Per CLAUDE.md the required pair scales with the change: UI-only changes need a code audit + an end-user/Joel perspective review; backend changes touching a DB migration or a third-party API need a code audit + an API/schema correctness review. Either pairing satisfies this check. If two qualifying agents ran and their findings were addressed, allow the push by outputting nothing at all - no commentary, no explanation, completely empty output. Only if fewer than two ran, or findings were left unaddressed, output exactly this and nothing else: {"continue": false, "stopReason": "BLOCKED: Pre-deploy agent review incomplete. Per CLAUDE.md, spawn two review agents sized to the change (code audit + UX perspective for UI; code audit + API/schema correctness for backend/migrations), address their findings, then push."}
hooks.statusMessage: Verifying pre-deploy agent review was completed...

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit push\b'; then if git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'generated_ads.py'; then echo 'kie.ai change detected — running live /test-kie...' >&2; RESULT=$(curl -sf --max-time 30 'https://adbuilder-api.velocitymx.io/api/v1/generated-ads/test-kie' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$RESULT" ]; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "BLOCKED: generated_ads.py changed but /test-kie is unreachable. The VPS may still be deploying — wait 60s and retry, or check VPS health."}'; exit 0; fi; PASS=$(echo "$RESULT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); r=[x for x in d.get('results',[]) if not x.get('skipped')]; ok=r and all(x.get('body',{}).get('code')==200 and x.get('body',{}).get('data',{}).get('taskId') for x in r); print('yes' if ok else 'no')" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$PASS" != 'yes' ]; then echo "{\"continue\": false, \"stopReason\": \"BLOCKED: kie.ai /test-kie not passing. Both tests must return code 200 + taskId before a generated_ads.py push. Hit https://adbuilder-api.velocitymx.io/api/v1/generated-ads/test-kie to see what's failing. Fix the contract, verify the test passes, then retry the push.\"}" ; fi; fi; fi

hooks.prompt:
You are a senior engineer doing a pre-push code review for the Ad Builder app (BHM-Dev/iscale-facebook-ad-builder). Review the staged diff by running: git diff HEAD~1 HEAD 2>/dev/null || git diff --cached. Check for these 7 failure classes:
1. ALEMBIC: Any new migration file whose down_revision does not point to the current single head (run python3 scripts/check_alembic_heads.py)
2. MODEL/MIGRATION MISMATCH: New SQLAlchemy column added to models.py without a corresponding migration file
3. REACT AUTO-ADVANCE LOOP: useEffect that calls setCurrentStep without a skipAutoAdvance guard — Back button will loop
4. ADSET vs CAMPAIGN KEY: Any state or API call keyed on campaign_id when it should be adset.id (brand assignment, remix state)
5. META CDN URL: Any call to deconstruct_template or fetch of a Meta image URL without a try/except fallback to the generic blueprint
6. LOCALSTORAGE HANDOFF: pendingRemixCreative or pendingBatchCopy written but not read (or vice versa) — broken wizard handoff
7. JOEL UX REGRESSION: Any change to AdRemix.jsx wizard step order, CampaignPerformance.jsx Remix drawer, or BatchGenerate.jsx pre-fill that could break Joel's daily workflow
If any issues found: output JSON {"continue": false, "stopReason": "PRE-PUSH REVIEW BLOCKED:\n[issue list]"}
If clean: output nothing and exit 0.
